title: upgrade's pointer worklist names hits under .history that the append-only guard refuses to let anyone reword
body: Reported by courses-vc on e70c3528a. `intent upgrade`'s pointer worklist tells the reader to read and reword the legacy pointers it found, and every one of Courses' hits (7, all `st/COMPLETED/` names) is under `intent/whiteboard/*/.history/**`, which `append-only-guard.sh` refuses to let a commit change. So the worklist's remedy cannot be followed for those hits. `legacy::pointers` (legacy.rs:3728 at e70c3528a) scans every file under `intent/` except v2 leftovers; it should skip `.history/` (an archive is a record, not a pointer to reword), or the worklist should say those hits are archival and need no action.
